verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Gitea has an official CLI, 'tea', documented at gitea.com/gitea/tea, which directly meets the story's core requirement. The evidence is only a single existence-level mention, with no detail on what the CLI covers or how it works. Missing for 10: documented command coverage (repos, PRs, issues, Actions), machine-readable/JSON output and scripting or agent-friendly behavior, auth/token handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
